The api died because the `report-export` job filled the data disk, and it never came back within this log.

Starting at 03:05:00 the job wrote 40 CSV parts of 512 MB each (about 20 GB) into `/var/lib/stockroom/exports/`, one every 12 seconds. That volume is shared with the database: the disk hit 91% at 03:09:03 and 99% at 03:13:30. At 03:14:00 the db failed with `could not extend file "base/16384/2619": No space left on device`. The api then aborted its transaction, shut down its worker pool, and exited with status 1 at 03:14:06.

From 03:16:00 until 05:28:00 the proxy logged `upstream api refused connection` 67 times. There is not a single api line after the crash through the end of the log at 05:29:57, so nothing restarted it. The 43 `cache: slow command` warnings run throughout the log, including well before the incident, and look unrelated.

To recover, free space by clearing or moving the `part-*.csv` files in `/var/lib/stockroom/exports/`, then start the api. To stop a repeat, move the exports off the database volume or cap the job's output, and give the api a restart policy.

The log entries are dated 2026-03-09, not last night, so check this is the right file for the outage you mean. Nothing in this repo defines `report-export`, so I couldn't tell why it wrote that much.
